name: Lepsény (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Lepsény: a crowned blue and yellow shield with a church, a star and a plough, with blue and yellow mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Lepsény arms with crown and mantling
